acceptance_rule: IAPWS-2008 Table-4 verification rows must reproduce tabulated values to numerical precision.
n-hexane reference rows validate light-hydrocarbon transport behavior only to 600 K; target 653 K remains outside source range.
n-undecane provides a lower-EACN bracket; ingest n-C16/n-C18/n-C20 experimental rows before acceptance.
Squalane holdout is a saturated-heavy benchmark, not a mixed aromatic/resin Middle validation.
Squalane cannot validate real >500 C Heavy viscosity; require heavy-cut or reconstructed-oil high-T/P data.
Primary transport check feeds reference density directly to viscosity closure, isolating viscosity-model error from EOS-density error.
Only after intrinsic transport passes may EOS-predicted density be coupled to viscosity for end-to-end validation.
Reservoir transport validation remains blocked until oil pseudo-component coverage is adequate.
